purpose: Pre-registered evaluation of the no-headnote case-law rule-extraction method BEFORE the full ~3,179-case run. Two stages: (1) method ablation over 4 arms on a stratified sample; (2) a fresh disjoint holdout using the frozen best method, scored by an LLM-judge proxy AND handed to a human lawyer for authoritative labels.
population: CommonLII cases cached status=no-headnote (Track A found no Held: block), with local text

holdout.method: frozen best DEPLOYABLE (8B) arm from the ablation, disjoint from the ablation sample. The mass run uses the cheap 8B tier (70B is reserved for escalation and validated separately), so arm D (70B) is the ablation ceiling reference but is NOT eligible to be the holdout method.

judge.note: LLM-as-judge is a PROVISIONAL proxy only, and (due to 70B endpoint latency) is run on a disclosed seeded subset of at most max_rules accepted holdout rules. The human lawyer labels in lawyer-labels.csv are authoritative for the GO decision and cover ALL accepted rules.

grounding_note: Verbatim/quote grounding proves the quote EXISTS in the judgment. It is NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT: a grounded quote may be obiter, a party's submission, quoted precedent, or may not support the paraphrase. Legal correctness is decided by the lawyer labels, not by grounding.
decision_rule: GO only if ALL go_criteria are met on the human lawyer labels. The LLM-judge number is advisory and reported alongside but does not by itself authorise GO.
credit_accounting: Report llm_client HTTP_ATTEMPTS (billable proxy) AND successful logical calls separately; the two differ because chat_json retries and falls back from JSON mode.
